plan.title: Draft line item save rejects empty quantity

steps.note: Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required vendor-addition configuration before opening the draft.
Apply the third configuration required by the case.
Open the first saved draft from the Drafts tab.
Open the Manage Line Items window for the draft.
Select the example product in the line-item editor.
Leave Quantity blank as the invalid input under test.
Enter the requested price while keeping Quantity empty.
Attempt to save the edited line item.

args.contains: Please fill valid quantity on every line item

steps.note: Verify that Procol refuses the save because the quantity is blank.
